FULL_RUN_AUDITOR_SUMMARY.reading: Every treatment invariant held for the entire run: 4,228 audited episode closes with zero pole-assignment drift, zero unknown opponents, all 32 environments observed with a minimum of 129 resets each, zero mismatches.

REHEARSAL.REPLAY_FACTOR_VS_V1: 49.42x here vs V1's 188.86x at the same nominal 1M budget -- a 3.82x reduction, close to the 4.2x the bank-size ratio (1804/428) predicted.
